card.name: Just before a person's first name
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before a person's given name in historical or biographical text, such as 'after', 'and', a comma or 'with' leading into a name.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A small word or comma that introduces a named person, such as a spouse, successor or leader.
modes.example: much to the chagrin of his wife<<,>> Dame Van Winkle.

modes.label: Year digit before a name
modes.description: The first digit of a year in a biography, with a person's name expected soon after.

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: Inside a longer personal name or title just before the next name part.

card.writes: It pushes up common first names like Sean, Jeff, Chris and Michelle, and pushes down old-fashioned names like Harold and Arthur.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a person, and it expects a modern-style first name.
